bootleap can now run as a GitHub Action and comment on the pull request that moves your build to Spring Boot 4, like the ones Dependabot opens.

### GitHub Action

```yaml
name: Spring Boot 4 check
on: pull_request

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write # to comment

jobs:
  bootleap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: JooaoGui/bootleap@v0.2.0
```

It stays quiet on pull requests that do not ask for Spring Boot 4, keeps a single comment that it updates on every push, and always writes the report to the job summary. See the [README](https://github.com/JooaoGui/bootleap#github-action) for the inputs.

### Also new

- `--format markdown`: findings grouped by rule, made for pull request comments
- `--only-if-upgrading`: only check when the build files already ask for Spring Boot 4

### Download

`bootleap.jar` below, Java 17 or later. `bootleap.jar.sha256` has the checksum.
